control.description-key: PBS Hub host app H-1 Hari ini: shift state, today sessions with the next step (absen, kirim report, perbaiki), open reports and the credit score.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: absenLeadMin (30), reportDeadlineDays (2), maxShiftHours (12), requireAbsen (true).

property.name: HostJson
property.description-key: JSON row of the signed-in host [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, HostCode, NamaHost, Package, CurrentScore, InitialScore. Never send KTP or bank data.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] for this host, last 7 days to next 7 days: Title, Date, StartTime, EndTime, BrandID, StudioID, Platform, Account, Status.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for this host, last 14 days: ClockInDate, CheckInTime, CheckOutTime, ClockInTime, ClockOutTime, CheckInOffice.

property.name: AbsenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host Absence - PBS Hub] for this host: Title, ScheduleID, LiveDate, Status, Created.

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report - PBS Hub] for this host, last 30 days: ID, Title, ScheduleID, LiveDate, BrandID, Platform, Penjualan, ApprovalStatus, ApprovalComment, Created, Modified.

property.name: ScoreTxJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreTransactions for this host, last 30 days: Point, Status, CreatedDate, Reason.

property.name: ThresholdsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreThreshold: ThresholdID, Label, MinimumScore, MaximumScore, Tone, Active, SortOrder.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeletons.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: CLOCK_IN, CLOCK_OUT, ABSEN, NEW_REPORT, OPEN_REPORT, OPEN_SCHEDULE, NAV, RELOAD.
